review_candidates.title: Construction Manager
review_candidates.description: About Kamen Kamen Construction Limited is a Nigerian construction and infrastructure development company delivering projects across the construction and infrastructure sectors. We are committed to delivering quality projects through technical excellence, effective project management, cost discipline and strong operational controls. We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Construction Manager to lead construction activities across our project portfolio and ensure that projects are executed safely, efficiently and in accordance with approved plans, budgets, specifications and delivery schedules. Job Summary The Construction Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and supervising construction activities from mobilisation through completion and handover. The successful candidate will oversee site operations, manage construction teams and subcontractors, coordinate materials and equipment, monitor project progress, enforce quality and HSE standards, and ensure that construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications and contractual requirements. The role requires strong technical competence, leadership ability, commercial awareness and the capacity to manage multiple work fronts while maintaining strict control over time, cost, quality and safety. The Construction Manager will work closely with the Head of Projects, Project Managers, Site Engineers, Quantity Surveyors, Procurement, HSE and other relevant departments to achieve successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities 1. Construction Planning and Execution Develop and implement construction execution plans in line with approved project programmes and contractual requirements. Review construction drawings, specifications, method statements and work programmes before commencement of activities. Coordinate site mobilisation, resource allocation and construction sequencing. Break down project programmes into weekly and daily work plans with clear targets and responsibilities. 2. Site Operations and Workforce Management Supervise daily construction operations across assigned project sites. Lead and coordinate Site Engineers, Site Supervisors, Foremen, skilled workers, labourers and subcontractors. Allocate responsibilities and ensure that personnel understand their work targets and performance expectations. Monitor workforce productivity, attendance, equipment utilisation and daily output. Conduct regular site coordination meetings to review progress, constraints and required actions. 3. Project Programme and Delivery Management Monitor actual construction progress against approved project schedules and milestones. Identify delays, critical activities and potential threats to project completion. Develop and implement recovery plans where construction activities fall behind schedule. Coordinate with Project Managers and planning personnel to update work programmes and forecasts. Ensure that site teams meet agreed daily, weekly and monthly construction targets. Monitor dependencies between construction activities, procurement deliveries, design approvals and 4. Cost Control and Resource Utilisation Ensure construction activities are executed within approved project budgets and resource allocations. Monitor labour, materials, plant and equipment utilisation to minimise wastage and unnecessary expenditure. Work with Quantity Surveyors to monitor project costs, identify cost variances and implement corrective measures. Ensure that materials are used efficiently and that avoidable losses, damage and wastage are prevented. Review construction methods and recommend cost-effective alternatives without compromising quality or safety. 5. Materials, Procurement and Equipment Coordination Prepare and coordinate construction material and equipment requirements in line with approved work programmes. Work closely with Procurement to ensure timely sourcing and delivery of required materials. Verify that materials delivered to site correspond with approved specifications, quantities and purchase documentation. Coordinate equipment allocation, utilisation, maintenance and availability. Monitor material stock levels and ensure that critical materials are available before scheduled activities commence. 6. Quality Assurance and Technical Compliance Ensure that all construction activities comply with approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards and applicable regulations. Coordinate with the Quality Control team to implement inspection and testing procedures. Ensure that materials and workmanship meet approved project requirements. Review method statements and inspection and test plans with relevant technical and quality personnel. Ensure that required inspections and approvals are obtained before proceeding with critical construction activities. 7. Health, Safety and Environmental Management Enforce the company’s HSE policies and project-specific safety requirements. Ensure that construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved risk assessments, method statements and safe work procedures. Coordinate with the HSE team to identify hazards and implement appropriate preventive measures. 8. Subcontractor and Contractor Management Coordinate the activities of subcontractors and specialist contractors on assigned projects. Ensure subcontractors understand their scope of work, programme requirements, quality standards and HSE obligations. Monitor subcontractor performance against agreed milestones and contractual requirements. Verify completed work and daily progress records before submitting them for commercial assessment. Identify poor performance, delays and contractual non-compliance and recommend corrective actions. 9. Client, Consultant and Stakeholder Coordination Maintain professional working relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors and other project stakeholders. Participate in project progress meetings, technical meetings and site inspections. Provide accurate updates on construction progress, resource requirements, technical challenges and delivery risks. Coordinate responses to site instructions, technical queries and construction-related requests. Ensure that client instructions and design changes are properly documented and referred for approval. Support the resolution of site-level issues while protecting the company’s contractual and commercial interests. Escalate significant client concerns, disputes and project risks through the approved reporting structure. 10. Reporting and Documentation Prepare accurate daily site reports covering activities, workforce, equipment, materials, progress and challenges. Submit weekly construction progress reports against approved work programmes. Provide monthly construction performance reports to the Head of Projects or Project Director. Maintain records of site instructions, inspections, material deliveries, equipment utilisation and subcontractor activities. 11. Project Completion and Handover Coordinate completion inspections, testing, commissioning and snagging activities. Ensure that outstanding defects and incomplete works are identified and rectified. Coordinate with relevant technical teams to prepare as-built drawings, test records and other required handover documentation. Ensure that completed works comply with contractual requirements and approved specifications. Support the preparation of completion reports and client handover documentation. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree or HND in Civil Engineering, Building Technology, Construction Management or a related discipline. Minimum of 8–10 years of relevant construction experience, including at least 3 years in a construction management or equivalent site leadership position. Demonstrable experience managing civil engineering, building construction or infrastructure projects. Experience managing multiple construction work fronts, site teams and subcontractors. Strong understanding of construction methods, drawings, specifications, project scheduling and site operations. Practical experience in construction cost control, resource planning and progress reporting. Professional registration with COREN, the Nigerian Institute of Building (NIOB) or another relevant professional body is an advantage, as applicable to the candidate’s discipline. Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Project or Primavera P6, Microsoft Excel and relevant construction management software. Willingness to travel and work at project sites across Nigeria. Required Skills and Competencies The ideal candidate must demonstrate: Strong technical and construction management expertise. Excellent leadership and workforce supervision skills. Strong planning, scheduling, and organisational abilities. Commercial awareness and effective cost-control skills. Ability to interpret technical drawings and construction specifications. Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to manage competing priorities and demanding project deadlines. High integrity, accountability and professional discipline. Ability to work independently, take initiative and deliver results without constant supervision. A proactive approach to identifying construction risks and implementing corrective actions. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The successful candidate will be assessed against measurable construction performance indicators. Reporting and Accountability The Construction Manager shall report to the Head of Projects or Project Director and maintain a structured reporting relationship with relevant departments. What We Offer An opportunity to contribute to significant construction and infrastructure projects. A challenging, performance-driven, and professionally rewarding work environment. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Competitive remuneration commensurate with qualifications and experience.

The company operates a modern facility in the 10th of Ramadan city, producing around 1,500 buses annually, including eco-friendly models that support a more sustainable future. Ability to interpret technical drawings, prepare reports, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced industrial environment. Previous experience in automotive or industrial facilities is an advantage.

CRM & Reporting Maintain accurate records of all hospital prospects, conversations, requirements, and partnerships in the CRM. Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular business development reports. Track KPIs such as: Hospitals contacted Meetings generated Hospitals onboarded Vacancies received Candidates submitted Interviews scheduled Offers generated Successful placements Requirements 2–5 years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Recruitment, Healthcare Recruitment, Staffing, or Talent Acquisition . Strong experience in B2B client acquisition and relationship management . Experience dealing with German companies, hospitals, healthcare institutions, or recruiters is highly preferred. Strong communication and negotiation skills. German language proficiency of B2/C1 or above preferred. Good command of English. Comfortable with cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn outreach, and face-to-face meetings. Strong follow-up and relationship-building abilities. Self-driven, target-oriented, and comfortable working independently. Willingness to travel within Germany for client meetings and business development activities. Preferred Background Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred: Healthcare Recruitment International Recruitment Nursing Recruitment Staffing & Manpower Immigration / Talent Mobility Healthcare Consulting B2B Healthcare Sales Hospitals / Healthcare HR International Education & Recruitment What Success Looks Like The successful candidate will be responsible for building a strong German healthcare employer network and creating a consistent pipeline of vacancies for international candidates. Within the role, you will be expected to: Prospect → Connect → Pitch → Onboard Hospital → Receive Vacancy → Match Candidates → Coordinate Interviews → Close Hiring → Complete Placement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Number of new healthcare employers approached Number of qualified meetings New hospital/healthcare partnerships signed Number of active vacancies generated Candidate submissions per vacancy Interview-to-offer conversion Offer-to-joining conversion Successful candidate placements Revenue generated from employer partnerships Why Join Us? Opportunity to build the German healthcare employer network from the ground up . Work on an international talent mobility business connecting global healthcare talent with German employers. High ownership and autonomy. Performance-driven growth opportunities. Opportunity to build long-term relationships with leading German healthcare institutions. Be part of a rapidly growing international recruitment and talent mobility business.
